violations.description: Preventing contamination from equipment, utensils, and wiping cloths. — --Cloth for wiping food spills was not stored in sanitizing solution (at proper concentration) between uses. -Wet Cloth found without saniti bucket.

Refrigerated Storage. — --Refrigerator or cold storage was insufficient or ineffective at maintaining potentially hazardous food at a temperature of 41F or less. - Top of prep cooler is ice filled/cooled. Corrected on site, more ice added, lowered container into ice.

Reheating food. — --Potentially hazardous food was not reheated rapidly so all parts reached a temperature of 165F for 15 seconds within one hour. - Beer Cheese, sauerkraut found at 145-155 after 2 hours of heating- Sent to landfill

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. - Equipment, shelves, need to be cleaned.--Ventilation hood system was not cleaned properly and/or as frequently as required.

Plumbing system. — --Plumbing system was not designed, constructed, operated and/or maintained according to regulation. - Handwash station leaking, not working at time of inspection. -Prep table drains into pan on floor and not into disposal.
Handwashing lavatories. — --Handwashing lavatory was not kept clean or maintained. - Handwash station not working at time of inspection. Leaking.
